title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. From the connected workstation, --test-machine reads declarations and opens sign-in on the registered Test Machine GUI, without a control-plane connection there. Unrouted hosts still receive nonsecret declarations locally. Every identity profile lives in ~/.yoke-browser-identities, which survives reset. Those profiles are the test machine's only login store: managed steps, installer approvals through BROWSER, and desktop mission pages opened with yoke browser open --project P --identity NAME URL all share one login, so one authorize per identity is enough. An identity never authorized refuses browser_identity_not_authorized and names the authorize command. Real-host proof remains pending.
surface: Installed browser identities reference and authorize help; successor Pack Linux procedure and macOS entry pointer to the complete browser-identities procedure.
gap: Source routes every Linux, WSL, macOS and native Windows login through the identity profiles; the desktop Safari and snap Chromium sign-in checks are gone. Released delivery and real authorize, reset and one-login proof remain pending.
review: Remote command, lease ownership, settings validation, quoting, OS GUI helpers and post-window outcome forwarding have source regression tests. YOK-5406 source adds the reset-kept identity store, yoke browser open, and one identity browser approval driver, each with source tests. YOK-5408 source carries the same route to native Windows. Live proof on linux-lab, test-mac-pro, windows-lab (WSL) and windows-native-lab is still owed: reset, one authorize per identity, then a managed step, a desktop mission page and an installer approval sharing one login with no second sign-in, logins surviving a second reset, and the expired-login refusal on the approval page.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
